Accomplishment
1. First Taiwan Born U.S. Judge as the Magistrate Judge for the Eastern District of New York

2. B.A. Summa Cum Laude in History from Yale Univ. 1985 and a J.D, Cum Lande from Harvard Law School 1988

3. Recipient of A German Chancellor Fellowship to Study the German Criminal Justice System 1993

4. Prosecuted War Crimes and Crimes Against Humanity at the United Nations International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia in The Hague, Netherlands 1998-2002

5. Chief Hearing Officer at New York Stock Exchange 2005

6. Former President of the Federal Bar Council American Inn of Court and Former Vice-Chair of Manhattan Legal Services

7. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 01/2019
